topic: Algebra: Systems of Linear Equations & Inequalities
theme: Optimizing Blend Ratios for a Chemical Refinery
difficulty_guidelines: The problem must require setting up a system of two linear equations with two variables, and then interpreting the solution set within the context of an additional linear inequality constraint. The solution must involve testing boundary conditions from the inequality to determine a maximum or minimum integer value for a quantity. Distractors must arise from solving the system incorrectly, misapplying the inequality, or misunderstanding integer constraints.
